Status: Backend contracts are implemented behind default-off flags. Mobile exposure and production enablement remain separate protected rollout gates.

This document records the current source behavior added by migrations 12 through 18. The controlling invariant remains the authenticated reading-feed contract: a signed-in automated feed may recommend only after one authoritative snapshot proves the active Inbox/Read next/Reading set empty. Search, profile editing, lists, tags, feedback, briefs, subscriptions, and notifications never override that gate.

Capability boundaries

Capability Server switch Dependency Authority boundary
Five-state Library, lists, tags, notes, change feed LIBRARY_V2_ENABLED accounts + library Reuses the canonical library revision; active-state changes can affect queue eligibility. Lists/tags/notes cannot.
Research profile RESEARCH_PROFILES_ENABLED accounts Future-discovery preferences only; every response says queue_override=false.
Advanced recommendation modes, reasons, explanations, feedback RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED accounts + library + reading feed Advanced batches bind a proven-empty library revision and current profile/feedback revisions. The reading feed may still persist a minimal authority-bound Recent fallback while this switch is off.
Optional interaction events RECOMMENDATION_EVENTS_ENABLED none Closed content-free evaluation input; never product or queue authority.
Public deterministic Lookup and suggestions SEARCH_LOOKUP_ENABLED none Metadata-only explicit navigation plus bounded local topic-vocabulary suggestions.
Public Explore SEARCH_EXPLORE_ENABLED Lookup Bounded local arXiv coverage with a not-systematic disclaimer.
Account-owned saved queries SAVED_QUERIES_ENABLED accounts + Explore Saves only a query definition; saving a paper still uses canonical Library/import.
Reading briefs READING_BRIEFS_ENABLED reading feed Queue brief when active; discovery brief only from proven-empty authority. Dedicated brief progress never changes or proves queue state.
Subscriptions SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED accounts + library + reading feed Stores explicit topic/category/author/saved-query intent; it cannot deliver over queue policy.
In-app notifications NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED subscriptions Discovery delivery is revision-bound and deferred for nonempty/unknown queue state. Push and email remain unavailable.

All switches default false. Startup rejects an enabled child whose dependency is off. RECOMMENDATION_EVENTS_ENABLED is intentionally independent because event collection is optional and product state must remain correct when it is unavailable. With READING_FEED_ENABLED=true and RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED=false, a proven-empty snapshot may persist and serve only a minimal authority-bound Recent batch so the final empty-revision recheck and reading briefs remain safe. Advanced modes, profile-derived reasons, explanations, and feedback routes remain disabled; Recent-only items therefore emit explanation_available=false, while configured enhanced batches emit true.

The mobile event sender is best-effort and in-memory only. It emits the closed 12-event/five-mode schema in batches of at most 50, uses UUID event identities and UTC timestamps, and erases pending work synchronously when account or anonymous scope changes. Disabling personalization removes account behavioral events; essential account save/remove/library-state signals may remain. A disabled or failed event endpoint cannot block Library, queue, or reader state. Account behavioral events are also fenced by the stored server preference, so a modified client cannot bypass an opt-out. The v0.1 server rejects every anonymous event batch with INTERACTION_CONSENT_REQUIRED: an anonymous session UUID is request scope, not verifiable consent, and guests have neither an analytics-consent control nor account Library state.

Account-private surfaces

All routes below require bearer authentication and return private, no-store, authorization-varying responses unless the code-first OpenAPI says otherwise:

  • /v1/library/... exposes five-state items, lists, tags, and one unified revisioned change stream. Writes are idempotent and never enqueue PDF work.
  • /v1/discovery/profile, /interests, /topics/{topic_id}, /authors/{author_key}, /reset, and /export expose revision-fenced preferences and separately grouped explicit, feedback, and inferred data.
  • /v1/discovery/batches/{batch_id}/papers/{paper_id}/explanation and /feedback accept only an owned, unexpired, server-created batch/item pair.
  • GET/POST /v1/search/saved list or store an explicit query definition. DELETE /v1/search/saved/{saved_search_id} repeat-safely removes only the caller's definition. It returns 204 for a present owned row, an already absent row, or an ID outside that account so ownership is never disclosed. The same transaction retires a linked saved-query subscription, scrubs its display label, stops queued evaluation, and expires pending match/digest notifications. Deletion is not query-history clearing and does not save, remove, or prepare any paper.
  • /v1/me/reading-briefs create/current and /v1/me/reading-briefs/{brief_id}/progress are the only brief authority. A reading-feed request may pass that account-owned brief_id and receive a nullable read-only {id,position,total,complete} summary, but only when the brief's exact library revision and queue/recommendation authority match the returned page. The feed cannot create, select, or update a brief, and brief progress/completion neither mutates nor proves queue emptiness. Creation uses stored brief_size (15–25, default/fallback 20) and, when no explicit mode is supplied, stored preferred_discovery_mode; profile lookup failure falls back to Recent. An explicit request mode wins. /v1/subscriptions, /v1/notifications, and /v1/notification-preferences also remain subordinate to reading-feed authority.

Public GET /v1/search/lookup, GET /v1/search/suggestions, and POST /v1/search/explore search only bounded local metadata. Suggestions are a deterministic list of at most eight {topic_id, label, source_vocabulary} records; they perform no external lookup or queue mutation. Opening a result is explicit navigation. To add a paper, use the canonical manual import contract or Library write; that pending save immediately suppresses recommendations in a compatible client. These public search responses remain Cache-Control: private, no-store with Vary: Authorization; an unsaved query is not server-side history.

Lookup ranking is deterministic: exact normalized arXiv identity, exact DOI, exact title, high title-trigram similarity, exact author plus matching title tokens, then related full text, with newer publication time and stable paper ID as tie-breakers. Explore uses auditable fixed-weight local fusion: direct text 1.0, a published citation-neighbor edge 0.25, and an explicit topic/category filter 0.125. Abstract-vector retrieval is optional and stays unavailable until a compatible query-embedding model is configured; the service never substitutes a fabricated vector score. Every response retains closed source diagnostics and the bounded/not-systematic coverage disclaimer.

User-selected Library reminders

An active Inbox, Read next, or Reading item may carry one account-private UTC reminder_at. Library v2 writes use patch semantics: omitting the field preserves it, JSON null clears it, and a future timestamp sets or replaces it. Reviewed, Archived, removed, or already-past values are rejected by the server. Moving an item out of the active queue or removing it clears the reminder. The post-import success action opens the same account-scoped Library editor immediately; quick saves remain silent.

user_selected_reminder is a closed in-app notification type with its own immediate|daily|weekly|off preference and an immediate default. Its worker locks the account, applies global pause, quiet hours, in-app enablement, daily budget, and the per-type frequency, and creates only queue-owned paper notifications. The idempotency boundary is account + paper + the exact microsecond reminder timestamp. The payload contains only the reminder epoch; it never copies a title, note, list, tag, query, or account identifier. Clearing, replacing, inactivating, or removing the Library item makes an old unread notification ineligible at list time. Dismissing a notification changes only notification state and never mutates or advances Library queue authority.

The notifications deployment flag independently gates creation and execution of reminder work. During rollback, already queued or expired-leased reminder work is safely completed without evaluation, while other engagement work continues. Mobile keeps an existing reminder visible and clearable but disables new selection and uses the neutral “Organize paper” import action. Re-enabling does not resurrect an arbitrarily old promise: scheduling and evaluation share a strict 24-hour overdue delivery window. A timestamp older than that remains visible until the user clears it or next explicitly saves the item; the editor then explains that the completed reminder will be cleared. Rollout evidence must exercise this dormant-work and no-late-delivery behavior.

Source terms and attribution

Lookup, Explore, suggestions, recommendation cards, and briefs use the repository's canonical arXiv metadata boundary. Preserve the paper's authors, title, versioned arXiv identity, and canonical abstract-page link; do not imply that Pakperk owns the paper. Pakperk is not affiliated with or endorsed by arXiv. Explore must show its bounded local-source diagnostics and not-systematic disclaimer. Topic suggestions retain source_vocabulary so a product label cannot be presented as an inferred user follow or a universal taxonomy.

The existing full-text and arXiv data policy still governs metadata, links, PDFs, and derived content. A repository fixture or successful search does not complete the release review: the exact enabled sources, attribution presentation, usage terms, quotas, and qualified content/legal approval must be attached to the candidate evidence before production use.

Feedback truthfulness

Accepted feedback advances recommendation_feedback_revisions. Batch build, persistence, and serve bind that revision, the optional profile revision, and the proven-empty library revision. A mismatch supersedes an unserved batch. Every response with a recommendation batch_id also carries the exact batch_metadata tuple: profile revision, feedback revision, algorithm version, and recommendation-policy version. The tuple is absent exactly when the batch ID is absent and is part of mobile cache validity. The batch is scoped to that authorized cursor page: a response may carry both batch_id and next_cursor, and the continuation page may have a different batch ID. A compatible client requires the same enforcement, queue decision/library revision, effective mode, and immutable metadata tuple before appending it. It retains each item's source batch and zero-based page-local reranked position for batch-bound actions and events, and never caches a heterogeneous merged walk under one batch identity. Generation runs through a separate account-owned job queue. A worker claims a bounded job, builds from the job's bound library/profile/feedback authority, and rechecks those fences before publication; it cannot weaken the synchronous reading-feed empty-queue proof. Each page's continuation coordinates and candidate rows are persisted so pagination never serves an unbound result set. The same-snapshot candidate read excludes every retained exact/base arXiv identity with feedback; not-relevant and dismissed items are hard exclusions. Qualified impressions add only a capped repeat penalty.

Relevant feedback creates a source=feedback primary-category affinity only when personalization is already on. For You can use separately labelled feedback or inferred affinity and must explain the actual source. Following uses explicit interests only. Reset All deletes raw feedback, the feedback revision, interactions, batches, and non-explicit profile interests. The profile interests/export surfaces show separated aggregates, not a raw chronological feedback history.

Explanation codes and candidate sources are closed wire enums. They include saved_query_match with source saved_query; a saved-query reason reports a real stored definition and never implies an explicit topic or author follow.

Privacy and retention

  • Explicit profile/library/saved-query/subscription data persists until reset, item deletion, or account deletion as applicable. Deleting a saved query hard-deletes its normalized definition and bounded save-retry bindings; only content-free subscription audit identity/revision data remains after its raw display label is scrubbed.
  • Research-profile retry bindings expire after 30 days; saved-search retry bindings use a bounded server-assigned expiry.
  • Recommendation batches and candidates currently expire after 24 hours. Content-free interaction events expire after 90 days, and raw recommendation feedback after 180 days. Terminal/dormant/expired-lease recommendation generation jobs older than 30 days are removed by bounded maintenance.
  • Reading briefs expire after 35 days. In-app notifications, engagement retry/idempotency rows, and completed/failed notification work expire after 30 days. Hourly maintenance caps each table deletion at 1,000 rows per pass.
  • Unsaved Lookup/suggestion/Explore and submitted import text are not stored as server query history. Search logs and telemetry must never contain raw query, title, URL, account, paper, cursor, token, private note, reason detail, or notification payload.
  • Account deletion cascades all account-owned Plan 02 rows. Public paper and canonical topic metadata remain because they are not account-owned.

See the Privacy Notice, observability runbook, and account-deletion runbook for the operational policy and protected evidence requirements.

Rollout and rollback

Migrations 12–18 are additive over deployed schema 11. Exercise the exact 11-to-18 path from a verified isolated restore, preserve schema 18 during a feature rollback, and re-forward after a schema-compatible old-code exercise. Do not use a down migration to close a capability.

Migration 12 is an expand migration, not the physical To Read-to-Inbox contraction. While v0.0 code can coexist with or roll back onto schema 18, logical Inbox remains stored as to_read; v2 code decodes that alias as Inbox and encodes Inbox back to to_read. The legacy operation fingerprint remains unchanged for v0 replay, while a nullable v2 fingerprint carries the complete private-note/source/reminder intent for new writes. The legacy Library list projects Inbox, Read next, and Reading as its single to_read collection; the v2 state=inbox filter remains exact.

Before any Read next or Reading value is written, a rollback may use the verified v0.0 image against schema 18. After Library v2 writes are enabled, the rollback target must be the last expand-compatible image that understands all five logical states; v0.0 is no longer a safe code rollback target. Keep schema 18 and close the feature flags in either case.

Enable by dependency and risk: Library v2; research profiles; Lookup then Explore then saved queries; recommendation/event storage in shadow evaluation; reading-feed recommendation modes only after queue/privacy/evaluation gates; reading briefs; subscriptions; notifications last. Enforcement of the authenticated queue-first surface remains the final client-adoption gate. Rollback reverses those dependencies while preserving the ordinary public feed, existing Library reads, account deletion, and schema 18.

Before For You or discovery delivery leaves shadow, bind the offline evaluation corpus and result digest, generator/feature/scoring/diversity policy versions, source-coverage and topic/author concentration results, queue-leakage target zero, and accountable research/product/privacy review. Concurrency property tests must cover save/remove/account-switch/revision races; fail-closed tests must cover database, authentication, and source unavailability; retention and account-deletion tests must cover every account-owned class. These repository checks are prerequisites, not live-candidate evidence.

The checked-in offline gate includes an executable 18-case queue-policy matrix and versioned recommendation fixtures for explicit profiles, expected candidate pools, sparse categories, misleading title overlap, ambiguous author names, arXiv version duplicates, inactive historical-seed reasons, negative feedback, and small-profile changes. It measures Recall@K, nDCG@K, catalog/topic and cold-start coverage, diversity, novelty, author/category concentration, explanation correctness, negative-feedback response, and ranking stability. It also reports deterministic latency microseconds, micro-USD cost, generator invocations, generator-document work units, and external-request budgets with explicit units. Those resource gates do not substitute for manual relevance judgments, production latency/cost, online metrics, an approved A/B assignment and stop policy, or the protected production observation gates.

Repository tests and rendered flags are mechanism evidence only. Production requires the exact 11-to-18 restore/migration/rollback result, full feature-map dependency exercise, live privacy scan, retention cleanup observation, queue-invariant and alert canaries, signed-client acceptance, and accountable database/service/platform/privacy/mobile/release approvals.

状态： 后端技术契约已在默认关闭的标志之后实现。移动端开放和生产启用仍是相互独立的受保护分阶段发布门禁。

本文档记录迁移 12 至 18 所加入的当前源代码行为。控制性不变量仍是已认证阅读信息流契约：只有一份权威快照证明有效的 Inbox/Read next/Reading 集合为空后，已登录自动信息流才可以推荐。搜索、资料编辑、列表、标签、反馈、阅读简报、订阅和通知绝不会越过该门禁。

能力边界

能力 服务器开关 依赖项 权限边界
五状态 Library、列表、标签、备注、变更信息流 LIBRARY_V2_ENABLED 账户 + Library 复用规范 Library 修订；有效状态的变更可能影响队列资格。列表/标签/备注则不能。
研究资料 RESEARCH_PROFILES_ENABLED 账户 只影响未来发现偏好；每个响应都声明 queue_override=false。
高级推荐模式、理由、说明和反馈 RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED 账户 + Library + 阅读信息流 高级批次绑定已证明为空的 Library 修订，以及当前资料/反馈修订。此开关关闭时，阅读信息流仍可持久化一个绑定权限的最小 Recent 回退批次。
可选交互事件 RECOMMENDATION_EVENTS_ENABLED 无 闭合且不含内容的评估输入；绝不成为产品权威状态或队列权威状态。
公开确定性 Lookup 与建议 SEARCH_LOOKUP_ENABLED 无 仅含元数据的明确导航，以及有界的本地主题词表建议。
公开 Explore SEARCH_EXPLORE_ENABLED Lookup 有界的本地 arXiv 覆盖范围，并附带“非系统性检索”免责声明。
账户所有的已保存查询 SAVED_QUERIES_ENABLED 账户 + Explore 只保存查询定义；收藏论文仍使用规范 Library/导入流程。
阅读简报 READING_BRIEFS_ENABLED 阅读信息流 队列有效时生成队列简报；只有权限已证明为空时才生成发现简报。专用简报进度绝不会改变或证明队列状态。
订阅 SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED 账户 + Library + 阅读信息流 存储明确的主题/分类/作者/已保存查询意图；不能越过队列策略投递。
应用内通知 NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED 订阅 发现内容的投递绑定修订，并在队列状态非空或未知时延后。推送和电子邮件仍不可用。

所有开关默认均为 false。若启用的子能力依赖项处于关闭状态，启动会被拒绝。RECOMMENDATION_EVENTS_ENABLED 特意保持独立，因为事件收集是可选能力；即使它不可用，产品状态也必须保持正确。当 READING_FEED_ENABLED=true 且 RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED=false 时，已证明为空的快照可以只持久化并提供一个绑定权限的最小 Recent 批次，从而让最终的空修订复查和阅读简报仍然安全。高级模式、由资料得出的理由、说明和反馈路由保持禁用；因此仅含 Recent 的项目会发出 explanation_available=false，配置的增强批次则发出 true。

移动端事件发送器只做尽力而为的发送，且数据仅保存在内存中。它按照闭合的 12 事件/五模式架构发送数据，每批最多 50 个；它采用 UUID 事件身份和 UTC 时间戳，并在账户或匿名范围改变时同步清除待处理工作。禁用个性化会移除账户行为事件；必要的账户收藏/移除/Library 状态信号可以保留。事件端点被禁用或发生故障绝不能阻塞 Library、队列或阅读器状态。账户行为事件还受服务器保存的偏好设置隔离，因此被修改的客户端也无法绕过退出选择。v0.1 服务器会以 INTERACTION_CONSENT_REQUIRED 拒绝每个匿名事件批次：匿名会话 UUID 只是请求范围，不是可验证的同意；访客既没有分析同意控件，也没有账户 Library 状态。

账户私有界面

除非代码优先 OpenAPI 另有说明，以下所有路由都要求 bearer 认证，并返回私有、禁止存储且按授权变化的响应：

  • /v1/library/... 提供五状态项目、列表、标签和一个统一的带修订变更流。写入具有幂等性，绝不会把 PDF 工作加入队列。
  • /v1/discovery/profile、/interests、/topics/{topic_id}、/authors/{author_key}、/reset 和 /export 提供受修订隔离的偏好设置，并将明确数据、反馈数据和推断数据分组展示。
  • /v1/discovery/batches/{batch_id}/papers/{paper_id}/explanation 和 /feedback 只接受归当前账户所有、尚未过期且由服务器创建的批次/项目组合。
  • GET/POST /v1/search/saved 用于列出或存储明确的查询定义。DELETE /v1/search/saved/{saved_search_id} 以可重复安全的方式只移除调用者自己的定义。对于存在且归其所有的行、已不存在的行，或属于该账户范围之外的 ID，它都会返回 204，从而绝不泄露所有权。同一事务会停用关联的已保存查询订阅、清除其显示标签、停止已排队的评估，并让待处理匹配/摘要通知过期。删除操作不是清除查询历史，也不会收藏、移除或准备任何论文。
  • /v1/me/reading-briefs 的创建/当前端点和 /v1/me/reading-briefs/{brief_id}/progress 是唯一的阅读简报权限来源。阅读信息流请求可以传入归该账户所有的 brief_id，并取得可空且只读的 {id,position,total,complete} 摘要，但前提是简报的确切 Library 修订和队列/推荐权限与返回页面相符。信息流不能创建、选择或更新简报，简报进度/完成状态既不改变也不证明队列为空。创建操作使用已存储的 brief_size（15–25，默认/回退为 20）；未明确提供模式时使用已存储的 preferred_discovery_mode，资料查询失败则回退为 Recent。明确请求的模式优先。/v1/subscriptions、/v1/notifications 和 /v1/notification-preferences 也始终从属于阅读信息流权限。

公开的 GET /v1/search/lookup、GET /v1/search/suggestions 和 POST /v1/search/explore 只搜索有界的本地元数据。建议是由最多八条 {topic_id, label, source_vocabulary} 记录组成的确定性列表；它们不会进行外部查询，也不会改变队列。打开结果属于明确导航。要添加论文，请使用规范的手动导入契约或 Library 写入；在兼容客户端中，待处理收藏会立即抑制推荐。这些公开搜索响应仍采用 Cache-Control: private, no-store 和 Vary: Authorization；未保存的查询不会成为服务器端历史。

Lookup 排名具有确定性，依次考虑：完全匹配的规范化 arXiv 身份、完全匹配的 DOI、完全匹配的标题、高标题三元组相似度、确切作者加匹配的标题词元，最后是相关全文；发布时间较新和稳定论文 ID 用于打破平局。Explore 采用可审计、固定权重的本地融合：直接文本为 1.0，已发布引用邻居边为 0.25，明确主题/分类筛选为 0.125。摘要向量检索是可选的；在配置兼容的查询嵌入模型前始终不可用，服务绝不会用虚构的向量分数代替它。每个响应都会保留闭合集合的来源诊断，以及有界/非系统性覆盖范围免责声明。

用户选择的 Library 提醒

有效的 Inbox、Read next 或 Reading 项目可以带有一个账户私有的 UTC reminder_at。Library v2 写入采用补丁语义：省略字段会保留原值；JSON null 会清除该值；未来时间戳会设置或替换该值。Reviewed、Archived、已移除或已过期的值会被服务器拒绝。将项目移出有效队列或移除项目会清除提醒。导入成功后的操作会立即打开同一个账户范围的 Library 编辑器；快捷收藏仍保持静默。

user_selected_reminder 是闭合的应用内通知类型，拥有自己的 immediate|daily|weekly|off 偏好设置，默认值为 immediate。其 worker 会锁定账户，应用全局暂停、免打扰时段、应用内启用状态、每日预算及按类型频率，并只创建归队列所有的论文通知。幂等性边界是账户 + 论文 + 精确到微秒的提醒时间戳。载荷只包含提醒纪元；绝不会复制标题、备注、列表、标签、查询或账户标识符。清除、替换、使 Library 项目失效或移除项目，都会让旧的未读通知在列表查询时失去资格。关闭通知只会改变通知状态，绝不会改变或推进 Library 队列的权威状态。

通知部署标志独立控制提醒工作的创建和执行。回滚期间，已排队或租约过期的提醒工作会安全结束且不进行评估，其他互动工作会继续。移动端会让已有提醒保持可见且可清除，但禁用新提醒选择，并使用中性的“整理论文”导入操作。重新启用不会复活任意久远的承诺：调度与评估共用严格的 24 小时逾期投递窗口。早于该窗口的时间戳会保持可见，直到用户清除它或再次明确收藏该项目；编辑器随后会说明已完成的提醒将被清除。分阶段发布证据必须演练这种休眠工作和禁止延迟投递的行为。

来源条款与署名

Lookup、Explore、建议、推荐卡片和阅读简报使用仓库的规范 arXiv 元数据边界。保留论文作者、标题、带版本的 arXiv 身份和规范摘要页链接；不得暗示论文归 Pakperk 所有。Pakperk 与 arXiv 不存在关联，也未获得 arXiv 背书。Explore 必须显示其有界本地来源诊断和“非系统性检索”免责声明。主题建议会保留 source_vocabulary，因此产品标签不能被描述为推断得到的用户关注项或通用分类法。

现有的全文与 arXiv 数据策略仍然管辖元数据、链接、PDF 和派生内容。仓库测试固件或成功搜索并不能完成发布审查：生产使用前，必须在候选版本证据中附上确切启用的来源、署名呈现方式、使用条款、配额，以及有资质的内容/法律批准。

反馈的真实性

接受反馈会推进 recommendation_feedback_revisions。批次构建、持久化和提供服务会绑定该修订、可选资料修订和已证明为空的 Library 修订。若不匹配，尚未提供服务的批次会被取代。每个包含推荐 batch_id 的响应还会携带确切的 batch_metadata 元组：资料修订、反馈修订、算法版本和推荐策略版本。仅当批次 ID 不存在时该元组才不存在，而且它是移动缓存有效性的一部分。批次的范围限定为对应的已授权游标页面：响应可以同时携带 batch_id 和 next_cursor，而续页可以使用不同的批次 ID。兼容客户端只有在强制规则、队列决策/Library 修订、生效模式和不可变元数据元组都相同时，才会追加页面。客户端会保留每个项目的来源批次和从零开始的页内重排位置，用于绑定批次的操作与事件；它绝不会把包含不同批次的合并遍历缓存到同一个批次身份下。生成通过归账户所有的独立任务队列运行。worker 会认领有界任务，基于任务所绑定的 Library/资料/反馈权限构建，并在发布前重新检查这些隔离线；它不能削弱同步阅读信息流对空队列的证明。每页的续页坐标和候选行会被持久化，因此分页绝不会提供未绑定的结果集。同一快照中的候选读取会排除反馈中保留的每个确切/基础 arXiv 身份；不相关和已关闭项目是硬排除项。符合条件的曝光只会增加一个有上限的重复惩罚。

只有已经开启个性化时，相关反馈才会创建 source=feedback 的主分类亲和度。For You 可以使用另行标注的反馈或推断亲和度，并且必须说明实际来源。Following 只使用明确兴趣。Reset All 会删除原始反馈、反馈修订、交互、批次和非明确资料兴趣。资料兴趣/导出界面显示分离的聚合结果，而不是原始的按时间排列反馈历史。

说明代码和候选来源是闭合的线协议枚举。其中包括 saved_query_match，其来源为 saved_query；已保存查询理由会报告真实存储的定义，绝不会暗示用户明确关注了某个主题或作者。

隐私与保留

  • 明确的资料/Library/已保存查询/订阅数据会保留到相应的重置、项目删除或账户删除。删除已保存查询会硬删除其规范化定义和有界收藏重试绑定；清除其原始显示标签后，只保留不含内容的订阅审计身份/修订数据。
  • 研究资料重试绑定 30 天后过期；已保存搜索重试绑定使用服务器分配的有界到期时间。
  • 推荐批次和候选项当前 24 小时后过期。不含内容的交互事件 90 天后过期，原始推荐反馈 180 天后过期。超过 30 天的终态/休眠/租约过期推荐生成任务由有界维护清除。
  • 阅读简报 35 天后过期。应用内通知、互动重试/幂等行以及已完成/失败的通知工作 30 天后过期。每小时维护中，每张表每轮最多删除 1,000 行。
  • 未保存的 Lookup/建议/Explore 和已提交导入文本不会存储为服务器查询历史。搜索日志和遥测绝不能包含原始查询、标题、URL、账户、论文、游标、令牌、私有备注、理由详情或通知载荷。
  • 账户删除会级联清除所有归账户所有的 Plan 02 行。公开论文和规范主题元数据会保留，因为它们不归账户所有。

有关运营策略和受保护证据要求，请参阅隐私声明、可观测性运行手册和账户删除运行手册。

分阶段发布与回滚

迁移 12–18 是在已部署架构 11 上执行的加法迁移。请从经过验证的隔离恢复环境中演练确切的 11 到 18 路径，在功能回滚期间保留架构 18，并在执行一次架构兼容的旧代码演练后再次向前迁移。不要使用向下迁移关闭能力。

迁移 12 是扩展迁移，不是物理上的 To Read 到 Inbox 收缩迁移。当 v0.0 代码可与架构 18 共存或回滚到该架构时，逻辑 Inbox 仍存储为 to_read；v2 代码会把这个别名解码为 Inbox，并把 Inbox 编码回 to_read。旧版操作指纹对 v0 重放保持不变，而可空的 v2 指纹会携带新写入的完整私有备注/来源/提醒意图。旧版 Library 列表会把 Inbox、Read next 和 Reading 投影为其单一 to_read 集合；v2 的 state=inbox 筛选仍保持完全一致。

在写入任何 Read next 或 Reading 值之前，可以使用经过验证的 v0.0 镜像对架构 18 执行回滚。启用 Library v2 写入后，回滚目标必须是理解全部五种逻辑状态的最后一个扩展兼容镜像；此时 v0.0 不再是安全的代码回滚目标。无论哪种情况，都要保留架构 18 并关闭功能开关。

应按依赖关系和风险依次启用：Library v2；研究资料；Lookup，然后是 Explore 和已保存查询；影子评估中的推荐/事件存储；只有通过队列/隐私/评估门禁后才启用阅读信息流推荐模式；接着是阅读简报、订阅，最后是通知。强制已认证的队列优先界面仍是最终客户端采用门禁。回滚按相反依赖顺序进行，同时保留普通公开信息流、现有 Library 读取、账户删除和架构 18。

在 For You 或发现内容投递离开影子阶段前，需要绑定离线评估语料库和结果摘要、生成器/功能/评分/多样性策略版本、来源覆盖和主题/作者集中度结果、值为零的队列泄漏目标，以及负有责任的研究/产品/隐私审查。并发属性测试必须覆盖收藏/移除/账户切换/修订竞态；失败时拒绝测试必须覆盖数据库、认证和来源不可用；保留与账户删除测试必须覆盖每一个归账户所有的数据类别。这些仓库检查是先决条件，不是真实候选版本证据。

已纳入版本控制的仓库离线门禁包括一个可执行的 18 用例队列策略矩阵和带版本的推荐测试固件，覆盖明确资料、预期候选池、稀疏分类、误导性标题重叠、模糊作者姓名、arXiv 版本重复、非有效历史种子理由、负面反馈和小幅资料变更。它会测量 Recall@K、nDCG@K、目录/主题和冷启动覆盖率、多样性、新颖性、作者/分类集中度、说明正确性、负面反馈响应和排名稳定性。它还会报告使用明确单位的确定性延迟微秒、微美元成本、生成器调用次数、生成器文档工作单元和外部请求预算。这些资源门禁不能替代人工相关性判断、生产延迟/成本、在线指标、经过批准的 A/B 分组和停止策略，也不能替代受保护的生产观测门禁。

仓库测试和渲染后的标志只是机制证据。生产环境要求确切的 11 到 18 恢复/迁移/回滚结果、完整功能映射依赖演练、真实隐私扫描、保留清理观测、队列不变量和告警金丝雀、签名客户端验收，以及负有责任的数据库/服务/平台/隐私/移动端/发布批准。
